_evidence: 0x00437888 (esi = a car record, spec rec[0x66fef0,0x41c,0..21]) walks the 22 car records at 0x0066fef0 (stride 0x41c, loop ecx = 0x16). Per record: dword +0x40 zero test (0x00437898; at 0x0066ff30 + k*0x41c), equality with esi (0x004378a1) and with the car pointers 0x0066d820 (always), 0x0066d82c (only if byte 0x007c2e6c != 0) and 0x0066d828 (only if byte 0x007aafd4 != 0); then |word +0x68 - [esi+0x68]| (0x0066ff58 + k*0x41c; esi's own word is one of them) is compared signed with the word 0x00629bdc and the count of hits with the dword 0x0062a7c8 (CF = count >= limit). The three car pointers are record-aligned pointers (points_into 0..22; 22 is one past the array, matching no record); the two flag bytes, the +0x40 dwords and the +0x68 words are unconstrained. 0x00629bdc (static 0x40) and 0x0062a7c8 (static 4) are tuning constants read by no other function; they are varied around their static values (-0x10..0x400 and -1..23) so both outcomes of each compare occur. Only fixed records are dereferenced, so nothing can fault.
